title: MATLAB Quick Reference
description: Look up a lesson idea, see its small example, and check a common mistake. Open the linked lesson for setup and practice steps.

entries.name: Show a message
entries.summary: disp displays a value. Single quotes can hold a row of characters.

entries.name: Name a value
entries.summary: A variable stores a value. A semicolon hides the automatic display of an assignment.
notes: Without a semicolon MATLAB also shows the assignment result.

entries.name: Make a row of values
entries.summary: Square brackets build a row vector, which is a line of values.
notes: Commas or spaces divide items in a row.

entries.name: Read one position
entries.summary: MATLAB indexing starts at 1. Parentheses select an item.

entries.name: Read a grid cell
entries.summary: Semicolons divide matrix rows. A cell is selected by row, then column.
notes: Write row before column in the index.

entries.name: Multiply each item
entries.summary: The dot in .* means element-by-element multiplication. Each matching pair is multiplied.
notes: Plain * means matrix multiplication, which is a different operation.

entries.name: Make an evenly spaced row
entries.summary: The colon form start:step:end builds evenly spaced values.
notes: The middle number is a step size, not an item count.

entries.name: Keep matching numbers
entries.summary: A logical test makes a true-or-false mask for selecting values.
notes: Use parentheses for indexing, not square brackets.

entries.name: Find an average
entries.summary: mean returns the average. For this row it adds three numbers and divides by three.
notes: For a matrix, check which dimension mean works along.

entries.name: Use a condition
entries.summary: if chooses a block of steps. end closes the block.
notes: Do not forget end after the if block.

entries.name: Repeat counted steps
entries.summary: A for loop visits each value in the row after the equals sign.
notes: The loop variable changes each time; do not reset it inside.

entries.name: Use an anonymous function
entries.summary: An anonymous function is a short function value. @(n) names its input.
notes: Use . operators when a function should work item by item on arrays.
